bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
work="$root/.worktrees/creator-menu-20261115"
stage="$work/.gace-menu-offline-stage"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = d8de8f8912ee1d19b2a2bf2171c6cb66d51783a5
newtag=create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8
newid=sha256:ee5a183876e7a9dfa437d49cc484afdaeef4cd386222603d461a705e3128c2da
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newtag")" = "$newid" || exit 74
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -aq --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=gace-createvdobot --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo POLLER_INSTANCE_MISMATCH; exit 64; }
old="${ids[0]}"
oldid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$old")"
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$old")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$old")"
base="${files%%,*}"
case "$base" in *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) exit 66;; esac
test -f "$base" || exit 67
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" config --quiet || exit 68
docker image tag "$oldid" create-videobot:rollback-pre-creator-menu-20261115
cat > "$stage/override.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8
    pull_policy: never
YAML
cat > "$stage/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:rollback-pre-creator-menu-20261115
    pull_policy: never
YAML
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$stage/override.yaml" config --quiet || exit 70
changed=0
rollback() { rc=$?; trap - ERR; set +e; if test "$changed" = 1; then docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$stage/rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED=PASS || echo ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED=FAIL; fi; exit "$rc"; }
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$stage/override.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll
sleep 9
mapfile -t now < <(docker ps -aq --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#now[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo POLLER_COUNT_MISMATCH; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "${now[0]}")" = "$newid" || { echo IMAGE_MISMATCH; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "${now[0]}")" = true || { echo POLLER_NOT_RUNNING; false; }
trap - ERR
echo CREATEVDO_DEPLOY_IMAGE=PASS
echo POLLER_COUNT=1
echo POLLER_STATUS="$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "${now[0]}")"
echo CREATOR_POLL_READY="$(docker logs --since 3m "${now[0]}" 2>&1 | grep -q 'CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS' && echo PASS || echo NOT_OBSERVED)"
echo STICKER_SHOP_READY="$(docker logs --since 3m "${now[0]}" 2>&1 | grep -q 'STICKER_SHOP_HTTP_READY=PASS' && echo PASS || echo NOT_OBSERVED)"
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo CREATEVDO_DEPLOY_RESULT=PASS
